See deploy/INTEGRATION.md section 4.
session_id: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (a unique id for this session)
label: FL_B200_SESSION
o1_entry_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (the O1 pod-side entry; o1_b200/deploy/start_b200.sh is currently a refusing stub — recorded gap, out of FL scope)
o1_completion_markers: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (paths O1 writes when it finishes, e.g. /outputs/FINAL_STATUS.json)
o1_hash_manifests: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (O1's own manifests, e.g. /outputs/records.jsonl.sha256 or a TRANSFER_MANIFEST.json)
o1_transfer_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (the O1 result upload; FL only runs it and checks the return code)
session_authorized_seconds: UNRESOLVED_SESSION_TIME (authorized runtime for the WHOLE session; FL receives what remains after O1 closes)
fl_transfer_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (upload FL_ARTIFACTS.zip to the FL results repository — SEPARATE from the O1 results repository)
terminate_command: UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_BOUND (terminate — never merely stop — the accelerator)
